verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only the web-based SOSPortal (filing, searching, ordering copies) and downloadable PDF forms. None of it mentions an API, an OpenAPI document or any other machine-readable specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
